description: This Java class 'XmlStringMatcher' is part of the mockserver project, used for matching XML strings in testing or mocking scenarios. It utilizes XMLUnit for XML comparison and integrates with mockserver logging.

classes.name: XmlStringMatcher
classes.description: A matcher class for comparing XML strings, using XMLUnit to determine similarity and differences, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: XmlStringMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matcher with a string or NottableString, setting up the DiffBuilder for XML comparison.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if a given XML string matches the expected pattern, optionally with a context for differences.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher is null or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods, specifically 'mockServerLogger' and 'diffBuilder'.
